coverage.selection: two hand-audited illustrative policies; not probability sampled

records.pledgeParaphrase: Rejoin the Paris Climate Agreement promptly after taking office.
records.successCriterion: United States becomes a party to the Paris Agreement again.

events.description: President signed the instrument of acceptance.
The United States officially became a party again.

secondaryComparison.note: External benchmark; source promise also includes other climate diplomacy actions. This record isolates the rejoin commitment.

ambiguityNotes: Party platform language contains multiple climate commitments; only Paris reentry is coded here.
Outcome at February 2021 does not infer later administrations' policy or persistence.

records.pledgeParaphrase: Raise the nationwide federal minimum wage to $15 an hour and end the tipped minimum wage.
records.successCriterion: Federal minimum wage of $15 applies nationally to covered workers, with elimination of federal tipped subminimum wage.

events.description: Administration included a nationwide $15 minimum-wage proposal in its American Rescue Plan policy package; provision removed during legislative process.
Executive Order 14026 required a $15 minimum for covered federal contract workers; did not establish a nationwide private-sector wage floor.
External assessment finds the nationwide federal minimum remained at $7.25 and the national pledge was not enacted.
Successor administration revoked the contractor-specific executive order; do not score this as Biden's end-term pledge outcome.

secondaryComparison.note: Independent outlet's outcome classification differs from our action-sensitive four-point coding; not evidence of bad faith.

ambiguityNotes: The legislative route included a procedural constraint; evidence does not demonstrate every possible legislative path was impossible.
Narrower contractor coverage is implementation activity, not attainment of a nationwide statutory minimum wage.
The campaign pledged an end to tipped minimums; verify nationwide tipped-wage status independently before final adjudication.
Policy reversal in 2025 is recorded as persistence information, not scored against Biden's 2021–2025 term.
